name: Hazel Dunn
source: A self-appointed girl next door in a new neighborhood has had little to no intimacy thanks to her hubby's new work schedule. With time and unsatisfied yearning, she sought friendship with her neighbors, the St. Clouds. The vibe she felt was positively alluring, and she felt a mature attraction blooming as well. She would never have guessed that night whne she invited them over for a simple dinner would snowball into an invitation for her to explore her untapped sexual fantasies.
